versions.subject: Create  Abuse Nslookup with DNS Records (#3773)
Merge PR #4479 From @frack113 - Upgrade Rules Status
Merge PR #4519 from @fukusuket - Update PowerShell Classic Rule To Use `Data` Field
versions.detection:
selection:
    Data|contains|all:
        - 'powershell'
        - 'nslookup'
        - '[1]'
    Data|contains:
        - '-q=txt http'
        - '-querytype=txt http'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Data="*powershell*" Data="*nslookup*" Data="*[1]*" Data IN ("*-q=txt http*", "*-querytype=txt http*")
